meta.title: AHO for real estate agents — publish once, distribute everywhere
meta.description: AHO is a real-estate platform built for working agents. One source of truth per listing. Auto-publishing to Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp Business. Pro Automation $99/mo, 7-day free trial.

hero.headline: Your listings, on every channel — by 9 AM.
hero.sub: AHO publishes once and distributes to Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp Business automatically. Stop juggling tabs.

problem.heading: Right now you're…
bullets: Manually re-posting the same listing to Facebook, Instagram, your website, and a WhatsApp broadcast list — every property, every time.
Receiving leads across five channels. You miss two of them.
Re-exporting photos for each platform's aspect ratio. Square for IG, landscape for FB, vertical for WhatsApp.

solution.heading: AHO collapses the workflow.
solution.body: One source of truth for every listing. One inbox for every lead. One subscription that handles social distribution end to end. You write the listing once; AHO does the rest.

items.title: Post once, publish everywhere
items.body: Connect Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp Business once. Every listing you publish auto-distributes — with per-channel image variants generated on the fly.

items.title: One inbox for every lead
items.body: Contact-form submissions, WhatsApp click-to-chats, email replies — all funnel into your AHO dashboard. Reply once.

items.title: Bilingual SEO out of the box
items.body: Every listing indexed in English and Spanish (with Polish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian on the marketing surface). Buyers find you in their language.

steps.title: Sign up — 7-day free trial
steps.body: No credit card to start. Cancel any time during the trial without charge.

steps.title: Add your first listing
steps.body: Photos, price, features, description. AHO optimizes images per channel — square, landscape, vertical — automatically.

steps.title: Connect your socials
steps.body: One OAuth click each for Facebook Page, Instagram Business, WhatsApp Business. Then every published listing distributes automatically.

features: Auto-publish to FB + IG + WhatsApp Business

items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.a: No. The 7-day trial doesn't require a card. Add one any time before day 7 to keep your subscription active.
Facebook Page + Instagram Business + WhatsApp Business in v1. LinkedIn is on the roadmap.

items.q: Can I publish in multiple languages?
items.a: Yes. Each listing has separate fields for English and Spanish content. Type both, AHO publishes both. Marketing pages also localize to PL/PT/DE/FR/IT.

items.q: What happens if a social post fails?
items.a: AHO retries automatically with backoff. If the failure is persistent (account suspended, content rule violation), you get an email and a dashboard alert with the exact error.
Yes. Cancel from the Stripe Customer Portal — access continues to the end of your billing period.

meta.description: AHO Pro Automation publishes your listing to Facebook Page, Instagram Business, and WhatsApp Business — automatically. Native Graph API integration, per-channel image variants, schedule + retry. $99/mo with a 7-day free trial.

hero.headline: Post once. Publish to Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp Business — automatically.
hero.sub: The marquee feature of AHO Pro. One OAuth click connects each channel; every published listing distributes itself.

problem.heading: The manual workflow that's eating your week
bullets: Same listing, five places to post. Per property. Per language. Every week.
Different image dimensions per platform. Re-export, re-crop, re-upload.
Manual schedules slip — listings show up Tuesday on FB, Thursday on IG. Buyers see chaos.

solution.heading: Native automation. Not a third-party reposting tool.
solution.body: AHO connects directly to the Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp Business Graph APIs. Your listing publishes through your own accounts; we just save you the manual labor.

items.title: Native Graph API integration
items.body: Direct posts to your Facebook Page, Instagram Business profile, and WhatsApp Business catalog. No third-party reposting middleman.

items.title: Per-channel image variants
items.body: Square for Instagram, landscape for Facebook, vertical for WhatsApp Business — auto-generated by Cloudflare Images. Zero re-export work.

items.title: Schedule + retry + dashboard
items.body: Set a posting schedule per channel. Failed posts retry automatically with backoff. Every status (queued, posted, failed) shows in your AHO dashboard.

steps.title: Connect your channels
steps.body: OAuth click each: Facebook Page, Instagram Business, WhatsApp Business. AHO saves the tokens encrypted at rest.

steps.title: Publish your listing
steps.body: Same form, same flow as before. AHO handles the per-channel formatting + scheduling.

steps.title: Watch the dashboard
steps.body: Every channel post shows status: scheduled, posted, failed (with retry). Failures email you with the exact platform error.

features: Auto-publish to Facebook + Instagram + WhatsApp Business
Unlimited listings + lead inbox + agent profile

items.q: Does this work with my existing Facebook Page?
items.a: Yes. The OAuth flow connects to any Page you admin. No new account needed.
Instagram Business only — Facebook requires it for API access. Converting your personal account to Business is free and takes 60 seconds.
Yes. Set a per-channel schedule per listing. Default: post immediately on publish. You can also stagger channels by hours or days.
AHO retries 3× with backoff. If still failing, you get an email + dashboard alert with the exact platform error message.

items.q: Can I edit a posted listing?
items.a: Yes. Edits trigger an update on each channel (or a fresh post if the platform doesn't support edits, like WhatsApp Business broadcasts).
